### Shop ‘Til We Drop?
Author: Jim Liebelt
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/shop-til-we-drop-homeword-november-24.html
Passage: Matthew 6:21
Points:
- Modern culture often mistakes abundant living for endless consumerism and acquiring material things.
- Christ offers an abundant life that is spiritual rather than material, intended to bless others.
- Earthly blessings should never be treated as status symbols, but as resources to honor God.
- Believers must examine where their hearts are focused and resist selfish materialism.

### Heavenly Treasures
Author: Annie Yorty
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/heavenly-treasures-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Matthew 6:19-21
Points:
- Widespread storage facilities and cluttered homes expose our inclination to hoard worldly goods.
- Material possessions deteriorate and remain temporary, whereas investments in God's kingdom endure forever.
- Responsible saving is biblical, but relying on physical wealth for comfort and security replaces faith in God.
- What we choose to store reveals the true condition and priorities of our hearts.
- Believers should let the Holy Spirit realign their lives and redirect their resources toward eternal purposes.
